headline: Housing prices soared in this Hungarian major city: 30 percent more expensive within a year
summary: Miskolc has seen one of the strongest home price increases among Hungary's major cities this year. The average price per square meter for used homes was HUF 596 thousand between January and July.
why: Housing prices reflect mortgage conditions and household demand, which matter for Hungarian real estate and banking sector lending.
